_comment: Interaction-shape divergences, declared deliberately (loud, not silent — same doctrine as the register's deferred rows). Each token keys an OO control that opens a modal/menu while WO acts directly with no surface. These are intentional: WO's direct action (insert-at-caret, toggle, inline marker) is the chosen UX, not a missing dialog. Verified 2026-09-12 against OO 8-x rig + WO @ebbb4c15a..
header-footer: button enters header/footer editing mode directly; OO opens a settings window first
pagenumber: page-number field inserted at caret directly (Word/Google Docs behaviour); OO opens a dialog
footnote: footnote marker inserted at caret directly; OO opens an options window
endnote: endnote marker inserted at caret directly; OO opens an options window
track-changes: track changes is a ribbon toggle (aria-pressed), not a dialog; OO opens the review window
displaymode: display mode is a ribbon toggle; OO opens a settings window
update-table: rebuilds the TOC in place with no dialog; OO opens an update window
dropcap: drops the first character inline; OO opens a dialog
linenumbers: toggles the inline line-numbers section marker; OO opens a dialog
hyphenation: toggles the inline hyphenation section marker; OO opens a dialog
watermark: toggles the inline watermark section marker; OO opens a dialog
insert-image: image insertion is the anchored popover on every tab; OO uses a modal only from header/footer context
asc-gen673: OO header/footer 'Close' opens a confirm; WO exits header mode directly
